tools.name: whoami
tools.description: The space, plan, API key (name, read or write access, reach) and the monthly request quota of this connection. Free of quota.

tools.name: list_buckets
tools.description: The connected buckets this key can reach, with their id, name and storage provider. Start here to get a bucket id.

tools.name: list_folder
tools.description: Folders, then files, inside one folder of a bucket. Encrypted items show no name. Use path "" for the bucket root.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search files and folders by name across the buckets this key can reach, with optional filters. Encrypted items never match.

tools.name: get_file
tools.description: Name, path, size, type, labels and dates of one file or folder.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the content of one file: text files, PDF and Word (DOCX) as text, photos (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF) as a reduced preview image. Documents and photos up to 25 MB, and the first 2000 pages of a PDF. Nubbo reads it on the fly and keeps nothing. Scanned pages and text inside images are not transcribed,

tools.name: get_download_link
tools.description: A temporary private URL to download one file straight from its bucket. Folders have none; it is not a share link.

tools.name: list_trash
tools.description: Items in the trash, newest first.

tools.name: list_labels
tools.description: The labels of the space, with their ids, names and colors.

tools.name: list_links
tools.description: Share links of files and folders, with their public URL and state.

tools.name: list_inboxes
tools.description: Inboxes (file requests): public upload pages that drop files into a folder.

tools.name: list_inbox_uploads
tools.description: Files received through one inbox, newest first.

tools.name: list_galleries
tools.description: Public photo and video galleries made from folders.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Projects of the space; a project groups folders from any bucket.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: One project with its folders and how many links, inboxes and galleries it holds.

tools.name: recent_activity
tools.description: What happened lately in the space (uploads, moves, links, inbox files…), newest first.

tools.name: get_operation
tools.description: The state of a move or rename that runs in the background, by the operation id move_files or rename_file gave.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a folder, and any missing parent folders, in a bucket.

tools.name: rename_file
tools.description: Rename one file or folder in place. Renaming a large folder runs in the background: check it with get_operation.

tools.name: move_files
tools.description: Move files and folders of one bucket into a folder of the same or another bucket. Large or cross-bucket moves run in the background: check them with get_operation.

tools.name: trash_files
tools.description: Send files and folders to the trash; restore_files brings them back.

tools.name: restore_files
tools.description: Bring items back from the trash to where they were.

tools.name: set_file_label
tools.description: Add a label to a file or folder, or remove it. Label ids come from list_labels.

tools.name: create_link
tools.description: Create a public share link for a file or folder, with an optional password, expiry and download limit.

tools.name: update_link
tools.description: Pause or resume a share link, or change its password, expiry or download limit.

tools.name: create_inbox
tools.description: Create an inbox: a public page where anyone with the URL uploads files into a folder.

tools.name: update_inbox
tools.description: Pause or resume an inbox, or change its folder, texts, password, expiry or limits.

tools.name: create_upload_link
tools.description: A temporary URL to upload one file straight to the bucket, for clients that can run code: send the bytes with an HTTP PUT (with the same Content-Type when one is given), then call complete_upload. The content never passes through Nubbo.

tools.name: complete_upload
tools.description: Finish an upload after its bytes were sent to the URL of create_upload_link.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Save content written in this chat as a file in a bucket, up to 5 MB. Nubbo passes it to the bucket and keeps nothing. For larger files use create_upload_link.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "get_file" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "read_file" is 608 chars, far longer than this server's median (81). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_download_link, list_links, list_inbox_uploads · Private data: whoami, list_folder, search_files, get_file, read_file, get_download_link, list_links, list_inboxes, list_inbox_uploads, recent_activity, rename_file, move_files, trash_files, restore_files, set_file_label, create_link, update_link, create_inbox, update_inbox, create_upload_link, upload_file · Public sink: get_download_link, list_links, list_inboxes, trash_files, create_link, update_link, create_upload_link, complete_upload, upload_file · Destructive: list_inboxes, move_files, set_file_label, create_upload_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_download_link, list_links, list_inbox_uploads · Private data: whoami, list_folder, search_files, get_file, read_file, get_download_link, list_links, list_inboxes, list_inbox_uploads, recent_activity, rename_file, move_files, trash_files, restore_files, set_file_label, create_link, update_link, create_inbox, update_inbox, create_upload_link, upload_file · Public sink: get_download_link, list_links, list_inboxes, trash_files, create_link, update_link, create_upload_link, complete_upload, upload_file · Destructive: list_inboxes, move_files, set_file_label, create_upload_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
